STORYVILLE COFFEE COMPANY

Licensed to STORYVILLE SEATTLE PIKE PLACE LLC on 15 May 2012 — 14.35 years ago — as Snack and Nonalcoholic Beverage Bars.

94 PIKE ST # 34 unit 34. In Corner Market.

Storyville Coffee Company at Pike Place Market is their first retail coffee shop featuring a full espresso menu, fresh baked and handmade Storyville pastries, Storyville Hardware products, and plenty of space for the customer to sit and enjoy the experience.
